title: [zlib:x64-linux, ffmpeg[zlib]:x64-linux] zlib debug library not found by FindZLIB

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

On vcpkg under x64-linux, cmake will always set ``ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG`` to ``ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG-NOTFOUND``. When requesting a ``CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=DEBUG``, instead, ``ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE`` is set to the debug library. This is a problem for some ports that consume zlib especially if they rely on ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG and ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE to point to the correct locations, such as for instance the ffmpeg port; see [here](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/9ac48a6c493523bd499a0ed613ab080af9246938/ports/ffmpeg/FindFFMPEG.cmake.in#L178).

More precisely, due to this bug, ffmpeg[zlib] compiles, but projects in debug mode cannot be linked to it. Here's a full test script:

```
$ find /home/***/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/ -name 'libz*.a'
/home/***/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/lib/libz.a
/home/***/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/debug/lib/libz.a
$ cat CMakeLists.txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
project(zlib_test)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
get_target_property(ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE ZLIB::ZLIB IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE)
get_target_property(ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG ZLIB::ZLIB IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG)
set(ZLIB_LIBRARIES "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:${ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG}>$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:${ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE}>")
add_executable(zlib_test main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(zlib_test PRIVATE ${ZLIB_LIBRARIES})
target_include_directories(zlib_test PRIVATE ${ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIRS})

$ cat main.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <zlib.h>

int main()
{
        std::cout << zlibVersion() << std::endl;
        return 0;
}
$ cmake . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=DEBUG '-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=~/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake'
-- The C compiler identification is GNU 9.3.0
-- The CXX compiler identification is GNU 9.3.0

-- Configuring done
-- Generating done
-- Build files have been written to: /home/***/zlib_test
$ cat CMakeCache.txt | grep ZLIB_LIBRARY
ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG:FILEPATH=ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG-NOTFOUND
ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE:FILEPATH=/home/***/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/debug/lib/libz.a
//ADVANCED property for variable: ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG
ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
//ADVANCED property for variable: ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE
ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
$ VERBOSE=1 make
/usr/bin/cmake -S/home/***/zlib_test -B/home/***/zlib_test --check-build-system CMakeFiles/Makefile.cmake 0
/usr/bin/cmake -E cmake_progress_start /home/***/zlib_test/CMakeFiles /home/***/zlib_test/CMakeFiles/progress.marks
make -f CMakeFiles/Makefile2 all
make[1]: Entering directory '/home/***/zlib_test'
make -f CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/build.make CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/depend
make[2]: Entering directory '/home/***/zlib_test'
cd /home/***/zlib_test && /usr/bin/cmake -E cmake_depends "Unix Makefiles" /home/***/zlib_test /home/***/zlib_test /home/***/zlib_test /home/***/zlib_test /home/***/zlib_test/CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/DependInfo.cmake --color=

make[2]: Entering directory '/home/***/zlib_test'
[ 50%] Building CXX object CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/main.cpp.o
/usr/bin/c$   -I/home/***/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/include  -g   -o CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/main.cpp.o -c /home/***/zlib_test/main.cpp
[100%] Linking CXX executable zlib_test
/usr/bin/cmake -E cmake_link_script CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/link.txt --verbose=1
/usr/bin/c$  -g   CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/main.cpp.o  -o zlib_test  -lZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG-NOTFOUND
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG-NOTFOUND
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make[2]: *** [CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/build.make:84: zlib_test] Error 1
make[2]: Leaving directory '/home/***/zlib_test'
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:76: CMakeFiles/zlib_test.dir/all] Error 2
make[1]: Leaving directory '/home/***/zlib_test'
make: *** [Makefile:84: all] Error 2
```

**Proposed solution**

FindZLIB could grow a vcpkg wrapper to ensure somehow that the correct variables are set. Currently it expects the debug library to have a "d" suffix. This works fine for windows (where the libraries are called ``zlib.lib`` & ``zlibd.lib``), but not for linux. See https://github.com/Kitware/CMake/blob/master/Modules/FindZLIB.cmake#L71

Another solution is to name the debug library on linux ``libzd.a`` on vcpkg so upstream FindZLIB finds it properly (as it looks for "zd"). This risks breaking other ports, and it breaks with the practice of not renaming upstream libraries (as per the developer guidelines).

A third (ugly, IMO) solution is to leave zlib behaviour on linux as it is, but instead patch consumers (such as FFmpeg) not to use ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG on linux, and instead to use ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE under all circumstances for linux.

There might be other solutions too, but either way, it would be nice to have this fixed.
